text_block_list.text:
I catch Сайленс Судзука standing around
the
practice track alone.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Why? My legs just won't keep up with
me...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, I shouldn't dawdle while at
practice.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Um, well... It's difficult to explain.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Running just doesn't feel good right
now. My legs
feel so heavy...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
I don't understand why this is happening.
It's not
like I'm sick or hurt or anything...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Сайленс Судзука lets out a sigh and stares
blankly
at the track ahead.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It seems I've worked her too hard. I
should
probably adjust her schedule so
that running
starts feeling enjoyable for
her again.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
